headline: Penn State Harrisburg tops the United East
dek: Penn State Harrisburg went unbeaten in conference play, scoring 53 goals across all matches while conceding twenty on its way to twelve wins, two draws, and six losses overall. Penn College pressed closely behind the conference's stingiest defense, while Keystone College finished the season without a victory.

pattern.text: Scoring is top-heavy across the conference, with a steep drop-off at the foot of the chart: Penn State Harrisburg's 53 goals exceed the combined total of Notre Dame of Maryland, Wilson College, Penn State Brandywine, and Keystone College.

wire.line: Keystone College suffered ten losses with no wins or draws, scoring one goal and conceding 102.

last_match.line: Penn State Harrisburg finished unbeaten in conference play and led the conference in goals scored.
